title: MST Company
statementMd:
The MST (Meaningless State Team) company won another tender for an important state reform in Berland.

There are $*n*$ cities in Berland, some pairs of the cities are connected by roads. Each road has its price. One can move along any road in any direction. The MST team should carry out the repair works on some set of roads such that one can get from any city to any other one moving only along the repaired roads. Moreover, this set should contain exactly $*k*$ capital roads (that is, the roads that start or finish in the capital). The number of the capital is 1.

As the budget has already been approved, the MST Company will profit by finding the set with minimum lengths of roads.

## Input

The first input line contains three integers $*n*, *m*, *k*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 5000;0 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{5};0 ≤ *k* < 5000$), where $*n*$ is the number of cities in the country, $*m*$ is the number of roads in the country, $*k*$ is the number of capital roads in the required set. Then $*m*$ lines enumerate the roads in question. Each road is specified by three numbers $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}, *w*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$; $1 ≤ *w* ≤ 10^{5}$), where $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}$ are the numbers of cities linked by a road and $*w*_{*i*}$ is its length.

Between each pair of cities no more than one road exists. There are no roads that start and finish in one city. The capital's number is 1.

## Output

In the first line print the number of roads in the required set. The second line should contain the numbers of roads included in the sought set. If the sought set does not exist, print -1.
statementZhMd:
<statement>
MST（无意义状态队）公司又一次赢得了别尔兰一项重要国家改革的招标。

别尔兰有 $*n*$ 座城市，其中一些城市对之间由道路相连。每条道路都有自己的价格。人们可以沿任意道路向任意方向通行。MST 队伍需要选择一些道路进行维修，使得从任意一座城市都可以仅沿维修后的道路到达任意另一座城市。此外，所选道路中必须恰好包含 $*k*$ 条首都道路（即起点或终点为首都的道路）。首都的编号为 1。

由于预算已经批准，MST 公司将通过找出道路总长度最小的集合来获利。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含三个整数 $*n*, *m*, *k*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 5000;0 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{5};0 ≤ *k* < 5000$），其中 $*n*$ 是该国的城市数，$*m*$ 是该国的道路数，$*k*$ 是所需道路集合中首都道路的数量。接下来 $*m*$ 行描述道路。每条道路由三个数 $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}, *w*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$；$1 ≤ *w* ≤ 10^{5}$）表示，其中 $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}$ 是道路连接的城市编号，$*w*_{*i*}$ 是道路的长度。

任意一对城市之间至多有一条道路。不存在起点和终点为同一座城市的道路。首都的编号为 1。

## 输出格式

第一行输出所选道路的数量。第二行应包含所求道路集合中道路的编号。如果所求集合不存在，则输出 -1。
</statement>
